entities.summary: Cristoforo Moro was a political leaders in Venice (1390, Venice – 1471-11-18), recognized as a landmark figure in the Medieval era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
